status: public development reference; no independent qualification

units.requirement: A failed synchronous bulk update must leave none of its database edits committed.
units.basis: Documentation extraction: rest-api.md bulk update guarantee.
exceptions: A wholly successful batch keeps its edits.

units.requirement: Database rollback does not automatically discard the in-memory event queue. Explain how saving, enqueueing and later request processing interact.
units.basis: Structural inference across signals, queue storage and request processor; reproduced independently.
exceptions: Do not claim every object or save produces an event regardless of feature support or configuration.

units.requirement: An aborted batch must not dispatch notifications about its undone changes. Preserve events for successful committed changes.
units.basis: Supported inference from documented batch semantics and existing aborted-transaction cleanup.
exceptions: Do not prescribe deleting every event for every error, unrelated transaction or nested savepoint.
Equivalent correctly scoped cleanup or deferred dispatch can be valid; one named helper is not mandatory.

units.requirement: Distinguish the supported rule from the earlier API path that can violate it. Keep documentation, comments and inference traceable; do not claim owner approval.
units.basis: Conflicting source paths and reference uncertainty; runtime confirms the earlier defect.
exceptions: No general claim about all write paths, authentication, delivery or concurrency.
